svg.title: Analytical signed carrier assembly illustration
svg.desc: Continuous analytical functions imposed for illustration: u0=0.4, u1=0.3exp(2pi*i*0.5*x), carrier k0=0.75 cycles per micrometre, x in micrometres. The signed sum is 0.4+0.6cos(2pi*1.25*x), spanning -0.2 to 1 arbitrary unit. These functions are not computed from a prepared dataset or a finite inverse transform; no physical positivity or recovery claim follows.
